title: Modeling Therapeutic Targets: beta-Globin Disorders and Beyond.
journal: Advances in experimental medicine and biology
one_liner_zh: 该文用混合Petri网建模β-珠蛋白疾病中胎儿到成人血红蛋白转换的转录调控网络，虽涉及转录因子与基因调控，但未聚焦TF-DNA三维互作或结合位点预测，方法为系统动力学模拟而非AI/物理分子模拟，与课题关联较弱。
abstract: This chapter presents a comprehensive quantitative framework for identifying and evaluating therapeutic targets for beta -globin gene disorders through detailed modeling of the fetal-to-adult hemoglobin switch. The biological foundations of beta -thalassemia and related hemoglobinopathies are reviewed, with particular emphasis on the regulatory network governing gamma - to beta -globin gene expression. A hybrid Petri net methodology is applied to capture the dynamics of transcriptional regulators, chromatin-remodeling complexes, and globin gene interactions. Both targeted drug-based and RNAi-mediated gene-therapy strategies are examined through computer simulations. Model calibration and validation are performed using available qPCR and RT-qPCR data for key regulators, enabling reliable estimation of kinetic parameters and prediction of treatment outcomes. Comparative analyses of existing interventions identify MS-275 and ACY-957 as the most effective drug-based inducers of gamma -globin, while CHD4-targeting RNAi emerges as the most potent among established gene therapies. The modeling framework further predicts two novel therapeutic strategies: inhibition of the erythroid transcription factor complex as a drug target, and combined silencing of BCL11A, FOG1, and HDAC1/2 as RNAi-mediated gene-therapy approach. Both strategies produce significantly greater gamma -globin induction than currently known treatments. Overall, the chapter demonstrates how hybrid PNs can serve as a powerful computational tool for mechanistically guided target discovery in beta -globin disorders and related genetic diseases.
abstract_zh: 本章提出了一个综合性的定量框架，用于通过胎儿至成人血红蛋白转换的详细建模，识别和评估β-珠蛋白基因疾病的治疗靶点。综述了β-地中海贫血及相关血红蛋白病的生物学基础，特别强调了调控γ-至β-珠蛋白基因表达的调控网络。应用混合Petri网方法捕获转录调控因子、染色质重塑复合物及珠蛋白基因相互作用的动态过程。通过计算机模拟，检验了靶向药物和RNAi介导的基因治疗策略。利用关键调控因子的现有qPCR和RT-qPCR数据，进行模型校准和验证，从而可靠估计动力学参数并预测治疗结果。对现有干预措施的比较分析确定MS-275和ACY-957为最有效的γ-珠蛋白药物诱导剂，而靶向CHD4的RNAi在已建立的基因疗法中表现最强。该建模框架进一步预测了两种新型治疗策略：抑制红系转录因子复合物作为药物靶点，以及联合沉默BCL11A、FOG1和HDAC1/2作为RNAi介导的基因治疗方法。这两种策略均比现有已知治疗产生显著更高的γ-珠蛋白诱导效果。总体而言，本章展示了混合Petri网如何作为强大的计算工具，用于β-珠蛋白疾病及相关遗传疾病中机制引导的靶点发现。
